Find the [[Dwarven]] Scout [[Rangil Ironbow]] and see if your new allies need any assistance.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}

===Objectives===
*Find [[Rangil Ironbow]] in [[Traveler's Vale]].

===Early benefits===
* {{w}} {{skill icon|Protector's Strike}}
* {{r}} {{skill icon|Debilitating Shot}}
* {{mo}} {{skill icon|Remove Hex}}
* {{n}} {{skill icon|Suffering}}
* {{me}} {{skill icon|Mantra of Frost}}
* {{e}} {{skill icon|Gale}}

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
Go out from [[Yak's Bend]] and start down the path toward [[Borlis Pass]]. When you come to the split in the road, go either west or north; you can avoid more enemies on the west path. Both paths re-join near an iron bridge. Cross the bridge and turn west, stopping just before the entrance to [[Iron Horse Mine]] to talk to Rangil and receive the reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Grand Mason Stonecleaver
:''"These thrice-damned [[Stone Summit]] raiders are making things tough on both our peoples. If ye had an inclination to help the Dwarves out with something... Listen, I recently sent a scout into Stone Summit territory, and I'm sure he could use the help of an extra hammer. If ye'd be willing to help him out, I'd make it worth yer time and give ye something in the way of some skills to aid ye on yer journey. '''Rangil Ironbow''' be the name of me scout, and ye can find him up '''north''' toward the [[Iron Horse Mine|Iron Horse mine]]."''

:''"Will ye lend us yer aid?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I would be honored to aid you.
| decline = I've enough trouble helping my own people.
| ask = Find '''Rangil Ironbow''' up '''north''' and see if he can use yer help.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Rangil Ironbow
:''"So old Stonecleaver sent ye, eh? To tell ye the truth, I do have a few tasks that I could use a hand with. I appreciate yer help."''

==Notes==
* This quest leads into a long quest arc, beginning with [[Minaar's Trouble]]. Because the quest giver for those is some distance from the nearest town, it will save some time to do the arc in one trip.
** Rangers and monks can further save time by doing the quests [[Stone Summit Beastmasters]] and [[The Wayward Monk]] alongside this quest arc.
** Although this quest serves to lead players to Rangil Ironbow, it is not a prerequisite to Rangil's quests.
* Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can learn all six skills by waiting until you can change your secondary profession, then taking and abandoning the quest once with each secondary profession.
